scope: Exact integer centered-chroma expansion; one existing native VP8 decode pair.

quietnessBefore.scope: Five-second aggregate Linux CPU sample and current load averages. Recheck immediately before and after every statistical run; does not prove future hypervisor isolation.

quietnessAfter.scope: Five-second aggregate Linux CPU sample and current load averages. Recheck immediately before and after every statistical run; does not prove future hypervisor isolation.

nativeBuild.purpose: Original development-only warm VP8 decode FFmpeg worker

baseline.boundary: Identical resident frozen VP8/ALPH input to independent owned RGBA8. Complete public managed Decode and disposal; native software webp decode, state reset, centered bilinear chroma expansion, limited BT.601 conversion through RGBA16, RGBA8 reduction, exact alpha merge and scratch/output allocation/release. One codec/conversion thread, normal SIMD. Native contexts and packet/frame wrappers reused; every call decodes and converts every pixel. Padded output rows exposed without a packing copy. Startup, I/O, IPC, hashing, validation and encoding excluded. One existing raster/input; no regeneration or quality enumeration. Decode does not require a matched encoder quality. Only this native keyframe/alpha profile is measured.

Statistical prequiet passes and postquiet fails under unchanged thresholds; independent quiet confirmation stays open.
